title: Rippers — Deeper Bonds
description: The campaign's Deeper Bonds system (Aaron Jolliffe playtest) for Project FU: bond tiers (fleeting/solid/eternal), 4-section Bond Clocks on solid bonds, a strength ladder, and invoke = +strength retroactive to the roll just made (via FU's check-push). Extends FU bonds without forking. P1: data model + clocks + tiered caps + invoke wiring. P2: the strength ladder (cleanse, cover-regen, attribute-die raise, skill grant), clock-fill triggers, and solidify-at-rest.

rippers-deeper-bonds.note: v0.2.2: fixed all 3 live-verified P2 ladder bugs. (1) Cover-Regen threw ReferenceError — getFuPipelines() was called but never defined; ported the fail-soft FU resource-pipeline detector (dynamic-imports ResourcePipeline/ResourceRequest/InlineSourceInfo, returns null+warn on drift so cleanse/cover-regen resolve). (2) Raise Die always said 'already at d12' — FU stores attribute dice as a NUMBER at system.attributes.<attr>.base (8=d8), not .current; raiseDie is now numeric (8->10, cap 12), and raiseAttributeDie + the scene-end revert + the picker all read/write .base. (3) Cleanse said 'no status' on a 'weak' token — per god ruling it now lifts one of the active FU affliction statuses {dazed,enraged,poisoned,shaken,slow,weak} + our 'affliction', reading actor.statuses: 1 qualifying auto-removes, several open a DialogV2 picker, none -> noop; the per-rest budget is spent only on a successful removal. Added FU-integration regression tests (33/33). v0.2.1: (1) LAYOUT — the injected controls are now a full-width horizontal bar appended as a SIBLING beneath each bond's FU row (flex-wrap), not a span squeezed into FU's flexrow that rendered as a right-pinned vertical column clipping off the panel. (2) LADDER UI — added strength-gated action buttons to that bar: Cleanse + Cover-Regen (str2), Raise Die with a dex/ins/mig/wlp picker (str3), Grant Skill (eternal); each shows only when the bond qualifies and disables with a reason when spent this rest/scene. (3) FIX — AFFLICTION_STATUS/REGENERATION_STATUS were referenced but never declared, so clicking Cleanse would have thrown ReferenceError; now defined ('affliction'/'regeneration'), with a regression test. v0.2.0: P2 strength-ladder effects (str2 action-cleanse via rippers-conditions + cover-regen strength×5 MP; str3 raise one attribute die a size for the scene once/scene; str4 grant one of their skills at SL1), 4 clock-fill triggers, solidify-at-rest dialog, and invoke→clock-fill reading the pushed bond name from additionalData.push.with (FU 4.16.2 check-push). Bundles Limner's CSS pass: tier accent moved to an inset left-edge so FU's own bond name/emotion/delete fields are never dimmed (was .rdb-tier-fleeting{opacity:.85} on the whole row), filled tier pills, brighter clock, real button hit-targets; class hooks rdb-btn--tick + rdb-clock--clickable applied. Extends FU bonds via flags; clock-strength -> bond.bonus. projectfu pinned 4.16.0/4.16.2.
